Do I need a college degree?
No. Qualifying education plus the PTIN, bond, background check and CTEC registration are the requirements.
How long does the 60-hour course take?
Online courses are commonly finished in a few weeks of part-time study. There is no minimum number of days, but providers set an access period.
Can I prepare returns while I wait for approval?
No. You may not prepare California returns for a fee until your CTEC registration is active.
Is the course available in Spanish?
Some providers offer Spanish-language courses. Filter for it in the provider directory.
How long is my course completion valid?
You must register with CTEC within 18 months of completing your qualifying education.
